summary: More deprecated community.aws aliases: aws_glue_connection, aws_glue_crawler, aws_glue_job, aws_inspector_target, aws_msk_cluster and aws_msk_config (community.aws names without aws_), and aws_kms_info, aws_kms and aws_s3_bucket_info, which now point to amazon.aws.kms_key_info, kms_key and s3_bucket_info.
